levels.title: Module 9 Level 1
levels.task: Return songs released in 2023; keep query simple for index-style filtering.

levels.title: Module 9 Level 2
levels.task: Return performances for venue_id 1 ordered by set_time.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM festival_performances WHERE venue_id = 1 ORDER BY set_time;
levels.hintMessage: Use WHERE on venue_id and ORDER BY set_time.

levels.title: Module 9 Level 4
levels.task: Return songs with weeks_on_chart between 15 and 25.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE weeks_on_chart BETWEEN 15 AND 25;

levels.title: Module 9 Level 5
levels.task: Return headliner performances ordered by venue_id then set_time.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM festival_performances WHERE headliner = 1 ORDER BY venue_id, set_time;
levels.hintMessage: Filter first, then sort by two columns.
